# Selected extraction source fixtures

`fixtures.mjs` generates tiny DOCX, XLSX, RFC822 email and ZIP inputs, and reads the frozen synthetic PNG. The runner needs no external tools. These MIME families are advertised in `src/uar/file_processing/kreuzberg.rs`. Images also require the existing OCR configuration. The document cases exercise public knowledge-base upload, indexing status and retrieval.

Office, spreadsheet, email and archive inputs contain coefficient 73 and synthetic seal TEAL-7319. The grayscale 440 × 148 PNG renders FACT 73 in 72 px Roboto Bold from the pinned DevTools assets. The retrieval query leaves the coefficient out. The mounted profile supplies the OCR prerequisite explicitly. The separate disabled-profile regression requires terminal rejection before any chunk becomes searchable.
